# Per-backedge reschedule checks on arm64 follow the experiment like
# amd64, and the wasm stride default never applies off wasm: the
# default leaf loop carries no morestack reference and no stride flag.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOARCH=arm64

cd m
logos build -a -x .
! stderr 'logosloopstride'
logos build -o plain.exe .
go tool objdump -s 'main\.spin' plain.exe
! stdout 'morestack'
env GOEXPERIMENT=preemptibleloops
logos build -o preempt.exe .
go tool objdump -s 'main\.spin' preempt.exe
stdout 'morestack'
env GOEXPERIMENT=
env GOARCH=

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/preemptbackedgearm64

go 1.27

-- m/main.go --
package main

//go:noinline
func spin(n int) int {
	s := 0
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		s += i
	}
	return s
}

func main() {
	println(spin(100))
}
